newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Jan 8.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Wednesday's edition of The Wall Street Journal:
- Ford is expected to sell Budget Rent a Car to a publicly held group of Budget licensees in a deal valued at about $350 million.
- Newmont Mining boosted its hostile bid for Santa Fe Pacific Gold to $2.15 billion in stock from $2.04 billion.
- Service Corp International withdrew its $2.9 billion hostile bid for Loewen Group.
- General Instrument said it plans to split into three public companies through a tax-free spinoff.
- Factory orders fell 0.4 percent in November.
- IRS Commissioner Margaret Milner Richardson said she plans to step down as head of the tax agency.
- St. Joe named a top Disney executive chairman and CEO.
- General Motors officials said the firm's loss of market share at home is part of a shift to faster-growing markets overseas.
- General Motors' plan to sell Hughes's defense business for stock could result in $3- $5 billion in cash proceeds for the remaining Hughes communications firm, or possibly GM.
- Stocks bounced back from early declines to set records amid mounting volatility in the markets.
- Latin American stock markets are rallying on expectations of economic recovery.
- About 50 stockbrokers are expected to be arrested on charges that imposters took their licensing exams.
- The SEC is preparing to bring enforcement actions in its probe of alleged "soft dollar" abuses in the financial industry.
- Viacom said it plans a $100 million pretax quarterly charge to close 50 unprofitable Blockbuster music stores.
- Apple received some help from Microsoft as the computer maker's chief told thousands of Macintosh fans the firm is still headed for a turnaround.
- Bond prices fell again amid limited buying interest and a developing view that the economy may be stronger than many expected.
- American Express stock soared 15 percent last month amid rumors of an impending merger.
